'''Cruisemissile Troopers''' were elite [[TIE pilot]]s of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] who flew [[cruisemissile assault craft]].

==History==
The spearhead of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], cruisemissile troopers typically comprised the first wave of full-scale Imperial assaults on [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] military outposts, launching in flight [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of twelve from the bombing bays of Imperial [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]]. They were armed with dual [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] and twin [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] launchers attached to the two engines of the cruisemissile craft, although they lacked shielding.<ref name="PotF2">{{KennerCite|set=Star Wars: The Power of the Force (1995 toy line)|pack=Cruisemissile Trooper|link=potf2cruisemissile.asp}}, description on the back of the toy box</ref> Unlike [[TIE pilot]]s, who were autonomous from their craft, cruisemissile troopers were affixed to their cruisemissile assault craft from the waist down.<ref name="PotF2" />

{{Military-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The only appearance in ''[[Star Wars]]'' mythos so far is as an action figure of [[Star Wars: The Power of the Force (1995 toy line)|''The Power of the Force 2'']] [[Kenner Products|Kenner]] toy line. In [[Star Wars Insider 113|''Star Wars Insider'' 113]], Keeper of the [[Holocron continuity database|Holocron]] [[Leland Chee]] stated that the Cruisemissile Troopers are to be considered part of [[canon]].<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|113|Ask Lobot}}</ref>
